note: Chevrolet S-10 pickup only (2WD S10 and 4WD T10, incl. ZR2/Xtreme/SS/Crew Cab); GMC Sonoma/S-15/Syclone and S-10 Blazer excluded, though the 1991 and 1994 GMC Sonoma brochures (same GM powertrains) are used as GM factory evidence. HP is SAE net throughout. Where 2WD and 4WD ratings differ, 'hp' is the 2WD figure and 'hp_4wd' the 4WD figure. Source groups: all GM material (brochures and GM/Chevrolet press releases reprinted on conceptcarz) = one; Wikipedia = one; EPA = one (1984+, displacement/cylinders only); NHRA = one; Consumer Guide and CarGurus are independent publications (CarGurus may echo Wikipedia). The Isuzu 2.2 diesel was 1984-85 only (GM 1984 brochure calls it new). No factory spec tables were found online for 1986, 1992-93 or 1995-97.
